members.name: open
members.description: The source TooltipProvider wrapper defaults delay=0, while trigger/provider props can configure hover delay. disableHoverablePopup=false permits moving the pointer into the popup through the primitive safe-region logic. Disabled Root suppresses opening. Popup side=top, sideOffset=4, align=center, alignOffset=0. The package documentation calls tooltips visual-only and requires an appropriately named trigger; essential information uses inline text or an accessible Popover. This reference explicitly hides the redundant visual popup from assistive technology. Required help is persistent inline text; the trigger describedby relation points to that help, never solely to the visual popup.
